## Visual and platform evidence

## Risk and checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not reformat unrelated files.
- [ ] Tests cover new or changed behavior at the appropriate level.
- [ ] README/spec/source/test citations agree.
- [ ] No secret, credential file, private prompt, proprietary fixture, source map, or local path was
      introduced.
- [ ] Security, persistence, release, and cross-platform implications were considered.
- [ ] Remaining risks, known issues, and intentional follow-ups are stated above.
- [ ] If AI materially assisted, the tool and personally reviewed output are disclosed below.

## AI assistance
